name: Context-dependent repetition bias
fact: Higher within-context repetition of an option is associated with biased choices, including higher subjective valuation and lower uncertainty for repeated actions.

provenance.title: Explaining decision biases through context-dependent repetition
provenance.quote_or_locus: We found that higher within-context repetition of an option was associated with biased choices including higher subjective valuation and lower uncertainty for repeated actions
